description: Machine-readable contract for AIML pattern add-ons in asx.mini-app.v1 manifests. Each app-scoped .aiml file extends the KHANARY AIML engine with wildcard patterns that bind captured content to specific ASX key operations and table writes.

file_convention.include_base: khanary-distilled.aiml is loaded first; app .aiml overlays on top
file_convention.priority: app-scoped patterns shadow base patterns; more-specific patterns always win

frame_syntax.description: App AIML templates emit XCFE key-frame strings that dispatch_xcfe_app_frames() intercepts.

wildcard_binding.description: AIML wildcards (* and _) capture user-supplied content. <star/> inserts the first wildcard; <star index='N'/> addresses the Nth.
wildcard_binding.star_to_row_body: Captured <star/> text is JSON-serialized as { text: <star/> } or merged into a declared @fields template from @assistant_patterns.

prompt_context_vars.@key: Active ASX key from the request context, if supplied

wildcard_binding.field_template: An @assistant_pattern may declare @fields to map star indices to named schema columns: { 'title': '<star index=1/>', 'body': '<star index=2/>' }

manifest_addon_entry.description: Add-on entry shape for @extensions.@available in the app manifest.

example.name: AIML Pattern Add-ons
example.description: Natural language patterns that write to app tables and update ASX keys. Wildcard * captures user content; context vars inject phase and user_id.

assistant_pattern_extension.description: Each @assistant_pattern entry may now declare key_target and fields alongside intent.

fields.id: Unique pattern id within this app
fields.intent: Semantic intent label (matches micronaut-control template intents)
fields.key_target: ASX key to update in the ghost shell after the operation completes
fields.fields: Map of star-index → schema field name
fields.guard: Optional AIML pattern that must succeed before this pattern fires (for DELETE)

invariants.AA1: An app AIML file may only target tables declared in its own @tables block. Cross-app table writes are not permitted.
invariants.AA2: KEY_WRITE and KEY_APPEND require an authenticated session (AimlRequestCtx.authenticated() == true). Unauthenticated matches produce a SESSION_REQUIRED response.
invariants.AA3: KEY_DELETE requires a guard pattern to have matched first in the same session. Unguarded DELETE patterns are rejected with GUARD_REQUIRED.
invariants.AA4: star_to_row_body produces server-stamped rows. The AIML template may not inject _written_by or _written_at.
invariants.AA5: App AIML patterns are loaded after khanary-distilled.aiml. More-specific patterns always take priority; shorter patterns in the base file do not shadow app-specific longer patterns.
invariants.AA6: key_target is advisory — it tells the ghost shell which ASX key to re-render after the write. It does not grant semantic authority to that key.
invariants.AA7: prompt_context_vars are injected read-only. An AIML template may read @user_id but may not write it.
invariants.AA8: The aiml_engine.cpp wildcard match is the only admission gate. No fallback synthesis is permitted when no pattern matches — the engine returns MISS.
